scope: Development HPO/search and existing mechanism diagnostics only, with a separate formal-resource observation subsection. No formal accuracy was used for selection; formal_partial reads existing resource metadata only. No server connection, model/checkpoint load, GPU work, tests, skills or Git commit performed. This report is a static ledger, not an experiment.

inputs.additional_diagnostic_outputs: Six existing JSON diagnostic reports from .experiment_private_20261117/development_snapshot_current/runs; individually SHA-bound below. Earlier duplicate copies are not charged twice.
inputs.source_limit: Local source explains timer placement and aggregation. Per-result code hashes, config/receipt provenance bind actual executed snapshots; current HEAD is not asserted to be every executed source.

accounting_rules: One row per65 launch receipt process identity. A multi-method CE cohort is one outer process; its member result.wall fields are explanatory subsets, never additional charges.
Use recorded actual_cohort_wall_seconds for each cohort, including initialization/restore/report overhead inside its timer. A running-prefix report stopped later is a lower bound.
Sum standalone execution.wall_seconds or diagnostic execution_seconds only once; these are recorded timer regions, not whole process elapsed measurements.
For resumed runners, execution.wall_seconds counts only newly executed stages after restore. Never sum all saved stage walls or charge inherited prefix stages again.

Frozen screen/full candidates each execute a fresh numerical stream; count each actual fit separately. Deduplicate only immutable feature extraction by(dataset,cache_identity_sha256), charged once per unique cache.

Use non-reused record-mode CE transitions as native-CE subset evidence. Reused donor seconds in readers and cohort/result duplicates are not added. Initial development CE diagnostic is separately actual work, not a tuned formal ER baseline.
Known stopped-process epoch segments and saved cohort prefixes provide lower bounds; absent wall values and unrecorded abort tails stay unknown, never zero.

Process timer sums include CPU/statistical work, IO and shared-device contention. They are not schedule elapsed time, utilization, FLOPs, controlled speed comparisons or GPU-hours. No GPU-hour estimate is produced.
Formal training costs are excluded entirely and must remain in the separate formal resource report. No requested extra experiments or model export is implied.

summary.cost_completeness: Lower bound of documented timer regions. Additional unrecorded abort work plus setup/tails outside timers and any unreceipted correctness/audit/operations are not included.

unknowns.unmeasured_work: Work after last saved two-member cohort report, potentially partial PSB reader work, until controlled stop. Its seconds are unknown; not treated as zero. Separate split PSB restart is charged its actual new-process timer.
Full continuation process cost is unknown. The known two-epoch wall segments establish a lower bound only; source checkpoint/logs were retained per D0027.
Actual startup/training before correcting unintended20epochs to predeclared5epochs is unknown and not zero.

caveats: No exact physical GPU occupancy was measured; CUDA-backed process wall includes non-GPU work and contention.
Standalone runner timers exclude model/data setup and resume restores; cohort timers include that work inside each native call. The ledger exposes this asymmetry rather than silently correcting it.

Frozen extraction values are the repeated original metadata timers preserved in results; original cache metadata itself is absent from the282-JSON snapshot. Cache save/final verification overhead is outside those timers.
The initial current/CE diagnostics and stopped branches are part of actual development expenditure even when not retained as final candidates.
No main-table performance or hypothesis benefit is established by this cost ledger.

aggregation_rules: Separate from the HPO/search subtotal; do not combine them as one formal-training cost.
Add each completed execution.actual_run_wall_seconds once. Fixed formal ER rows already include actual donor CE training; never add shared_ce_assets.shared_native_ce_seconds again.
HT/PSB reader process walls are actual additional executions and included once; they exclude shared donor gradient work and do not measure standalone full-method training time.
These are runner timed regions, not whole processes, schedule elapsed time, controlled speedups or GPU occupancy. Initial model/data setup and final serialization are outside runner wall.
The two current rows stay pending until completed SHA-bound actual metadata exists. No forecast or estimate is inserted.

artifact_integrity.source_files_hashed: Every snapshot JSON, launch receipt, numeric measurement source and local timer-semantics source has its own SHA256. No model payload inspected.
